title: Evidence and claims
lesson: Define each relation. Missing evidence is an explicit category, not a false claim.

relation.instructions: Using only the record, determine whether it supports the claim.

criteria.supported: The record provides evidence that the claim is true.
criteria.contradicted: The record provides evidence that conflicts with the claim.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The record neither establishes the claim nor contradicts it; the needed fact is missing.

state.record: The parcel was delivered on Tuesday.
The parcel was delivered on Tuesday.
The parcel was dispatched on Monday.
The door was locked when the guard arrived.
state.claim: The guard found the door locked.

state.record: The room was empty at noon.
state.claim: Someone was in the room at noon.
The windows were open at noon.

state.record: The customer paid the invoice in full.
state.claim: No payment remains due on that invoice.
The meeting went ahead as scheduled.

state.record: The parcel has a tracking number.
The parcel was not delivered on Friday.
The shop opens at nine on Mondays.
state.claim: The shop opens at nine on Monday.

state.record: The booking is for two guests.
The light remained off throughout the inspection.
state.claim: The light was on during the inspection.

state.record: Mira submitted the report before the deadline.
state.claim: Mira submitted the report on time.

state.record: Only the blue box was opened; the red box stayed sealed.
